blurb: Guests parasail using a winch system that reels them out and back to the boat without getting wet. Each flight lasts approximately 15 minutes, longer than typical flights. They also offer an evening waterway cruise through Mott's Channel and Wrightsville Sound to Masonboro Island with wildlife viewing.
extraNote: Stop all parasailing if wind speed reaches 14 mph or thunderstorms within 20 mile radius
